title: ClusterSitesAttachResult
description: Result of attaching Sites to a Connector Cluster (idempotent).

attached.description: Sites newly attached by this operation.

alreadyAttached.description: Sites that were already attached to this cluster.

multiAttached.description: Sites that, after this call, are attached to this cluster and at least one other cluster.

alsoAttachedTo.description: Other cluster UUIDs this site is attached to (excluding the target cluster).

notFound.description: Provided siteIds not found (or not in the organization).

forbidden.description: SiteIds the caller is not authorized to attach.
